**Historical, non-authoritative.** Generated from the maintained JSON records; do not edit this view independently. Source statements retain their original scope.

Canonical successor issues have not been created. These findings are inputs for discussion, not approved implementation briefs.

## SIM-F03 — salvage

Discovery evidence types, exact fallback and reversible transfer primitives can survive without the Stage-3B prerequisite ladder.

**Rationale:** Local closure does not confer global ownership; a one-time atomic bijection differs from unsafe per-tick erase/simulate/restore. Current owner wants prepared/declared chunks as an exploratory route.

**Scope / validity:** Narrow rectangles/quarter turns and proposed discovery algorithms; lifecycle model is not current World/Rapier integration. — partially_valid; obsolete universal dependency removed

Carrier performance is specific to the access method: safe byte-loop P1 cost more in the active fixture; safe memcpy P2 was near baseline, and Dual64 differs from native U128.
